title: MINALOC Strategic Plan 2024-2029
why: States ICT infrastructure gaps and uneven connectivity in local government and plans investment so local government has internet access (rungs 1-3).

title: ICT Sector Strategic Plan (2024-2029)
why: Reports 29 sectors and 2,098 cells connected in 2018-2024 (rung 3, share of local offices connected).

title: 2023-2024 Backward Looking Joint Sector Review Report
why: Cells supplied with IT tools and connectivity named a priority for local governments (rungs 1-2).

title: Request for Bids: Supply of Domestic connectivity services (Local internet capacity distribution)
why: Contract to connect public institutions including 4,745 on wireless broadband (rung 2 programme/contract).

title: Bidding Documents: Supply, Install and configure the Government network equipment and software
why: Government network equipment tender across 204 institutions, AFD-financed (rung 2 programme).

title: Project Implementation Monitoring Report No.5, Rwanda Digital Acceleration Project
why: Progress: 1,626 sites connected with new or enhanced capacity (rung 2-3).

title: More Rwandan Public Services are going Digital with the support of AFD
why: Loan to modernise networks of district and sector offices from 2023 (rung 2).

title: Rwanda Digital Acceleration Project (Project Appraisal Document)
why: 22 percent of cell-level local government offices lack broadband; most of 416 sector offices not on fibre (rung 3 share).
